bullets.text: Motorola's Budget Phones Lack Updates - **Motorola** ships the **Moto G17** with outdated **Android 15**, no OS upgrades promised.
Apple Ends iPhone Upgrade Program - **Apple** discontinues its **iPhone Upgrade Program** in the **UK**, introducing a new finance option.
AirTag 2 Enhancements Unveiled - The new **AirTag 2** features improved Precision Finding and a louder speaker for better tracking.
Apple TV's Crime Thriller Returns - **Criminal Record** season 2 premieres on **Apple TV** this spring, featuring London detectives.
Nvidia CEO Denies OpenAI Tensions - **Nvidia** CEO confirms plans for a significant investment in **OpenAI**, dismissing reports of friction.
Waymo's $16B Funding Round - **Waymo** reportedly finalizes a $16 billion funding round, valuing the robotaxi service at $110 billion.
SpaceX's Ambitious Satellite Plan - **SpaceX** seeks approval to launch 1 million solar-powered satellites for AI data centers.
New European Unicorns Emerge - Five startups achieve unicorn status in Europe, signaling strong VC investment interest.
